svg.text: Proposed resolved blockout • all five views at 80 px/m • flat gray • no texture or lighting baked in
A Real central slot: 0.90 m clear width forward of canopy.
B Symmetric chassis; repair plates / graffiti asymmetric.
C Two square rear pods, thick frames, separate light faces.
D Underside uses two hover skids; hidden structure is proposed.
E No wear geometry until silhouette works in chase view.
Approved hero controls the look. These exact hidden surfaces and proportions are proposed, not new approvals.
Source axes for drawings: X right, Y nose-forward, Z up. Body base Z=0. Hover clearance is separate.
